Static File #1 US research, 2026-11-04. Catalogue **o4**, runtime id **5**, base **0x6E0000**, owned `netdnas.bin`, SHA-256 **8f090617fa1ef420ad73ae2d1c960998c55259d372677804d2a1e07e1a182e16**. No game, build, replay, attachment, network request, live-memory read, encryption/decryption or target block operation occurred.

The complete707-instruction clear core was independently read, including both direction loops, initial/final bit permutations and all eight table accesses in each expanded round. Its sixteen-round Feistel/table structure, reversed schedule traversal and [parity/weak-key/key-schedule family](SYMBOLS_NETDNAS_DES_KEY_SETUP.md) support a **DES-shaped core** role. This is not a known-answer vector, standard-equivalence/security proof, original-name recovery or runtime-use measurement. Two independently complete adjacent status stubs are mapped only by their actual returns; adjacency does not assign them DES semantics. No gameplay timing or slowdown cause is established.
